contradictions.why: The ROUTE BREAKDOWN (pitch_detail) describes an entirely different trailhead and drainage (Jug/Found Creek to Bluff Lake and Cliff Lake, with a "Cliff Lake saddle" and "West Ridge") than every other field on the route (waypoints, approach, descent_text, road, itinerary), which all use the Arrow Creek switchback trailhead on Illabot Creek Road and a west-face diagonal ramp — with no Bluff Lake, Cliff Lake, or Cliff Lake saddle mentioned anywhere else.

Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest, Darrington Ranger District (Glacier Peak Wilderness)") agree with each other and are correct for this peak; access.fees/notes/rules look copied from an NPS Cascade River Road route (the sibling North Ridge route on the same peak has a clean, correctly-scoped access block with no such contamination).
